integrity: Two self-contained independently constructed exhaustive Python enumeration programs with recorded output; finite case only; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite enumeration and symmetry classification of the seven-colour optimum for one graph; the optimum harmonious chromatic number seven is previously known; no extension to larger projective planes is proved. Earlier unindexed nestings tables may overlap.
title: Eight optimal harmonious colour classes of the Heawood graph form one orbit
